result.summary: The image depicts a wide residential intersection that lacks essential pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks, traffic signals, or stop signs on the primary thoroughfare. The expansive roadway and lack of traffic calming measures likely encourage higher vehicle speeds, while parked cars near the corners may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers to the crossing location.

interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances, slow turning vehicles, and improve visibility by preventing parking at the corners.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This residential street features a sidewalk that is significantly obstructed by parked vehicles and debris, forcing pedestrians into the roadway. The environment lacks formal crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signage.
